faq.q1: How do I add a favorite environment?
faq.a1: Press the heart icon on any environment card in the ranking.
faq.q2: How do I change the language?
faq.a2: Go to Settings → Languages and Dates → Update.
faq.q3: What do the status colors mean?
faq.a3: Green = Normal, Yellow = Warning, Red = Critical alert.
faq.a4: Yes, go to Management and press 'Add Environment'.

hero.badge: Leading platform in educational environmental monitoring
hero.description: Monitor air quality in classrooms, labs and educational spaces in real time using IoT sensors, intelligent analysis and automatic alerts.

why.title: Everything you need to
why.description: EduAirControl integrates IoT sensors, intelligent analysis and real-time visualization to keep spaces healthy and safe.
why.card1Desc: Captures environmental data in real time from multiple devices.
why.card2Desc: Automatically detects risks and notifies before they become a problem.
why.card3Desc: Visualize indicators, charts and historical data from anywhere.
why.card4Desc: Helps improve air quality and the well-being of students and teachers.

modules.title: System
modules.description: EduAirControl integrates all the tools needed to monitor, analyze and manage air quality in educational institutions from a single place.
modules.module1Desc: Automatic notifications when air quality exceeds safe limits.
modules.module2Desc: Historical reports with environmental charts and statistics.
modules.module3Desc: Manage administrators, teachers and students from a single platform.
modules.module4Desc: Connect and monitor all devices responsible for measuring air quality.

howItWorks.title: How does
howItWorks.description: From data capture to metric visualization and alert generation, all information flows automatically through a modern, secure and scalable architecture.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Capture temperature, humidity, CO₂ and PM2.5 particles in real time.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Receives and transmits information generated by the devices.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Processes readings, applies business rules and analyzes risks.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Stores historical data, metrics and environmental records.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Visualizes indicators, charts and the status of each classroom.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Generates automatic notifications when a risk exists.
howItWorks.systemOkDesc: All sensors are reporting data. No environmental risks detected.

technologies.title: Technologies behind
technologies.description: We use modern tools to build a scalable, secure platform ready for IoT applications.
technologies.tech1Desc: Modern, fast and fully responsive interface.
technologies.tech3Desc: Efficient persistence for large volumes of data.

designedFor.title: Designed for
designedFor.description: EduAirControl offers specific tools for each profile, enabling efficient environmental management within educational institutions.
designedFor.user1Desc: Manage the entire platform, oversee campuses, review environmental metrics and generate strategic reports.
designedFor.user2Desc: View the environmental status of their classrooms and receive alerts to act quickly.
designedFor.user3Desc: Check air quality indicators and promote healthy habits within the institution.
designedFor.user4Desc: Monitor sensors, perform preventive maintenance and ensure the system is running.

cta.title: Let's build
cta.description: EduAirControl helps monitor air quality in real time, generate smart alerts and make data-driven decisions to protect the entire educational community.

footer.description: Intelligent platform for real-time environmental monitoring, helping educational institutions make better decisions through reliable data.
